content.heading: Guide for Accents
content: To speak with a Transatlantic accent, blend crisp British consonants with open American vowels and keep your voice forward in your mouth - an intentionally learned, theatrical hybrid designed for maximum clarity on old microphones.

content.heading: A statement of terms
content: I write FOSS full time, as a self-employed freelancer. For nine years the work has been the same: keep free and open source software public, spread awareness of it, teach people to use it, and help with their projects.

The terms follow from that. My tools have to be fully available outside the browser, for security and verifiability. Whatever represents my identity on the internet has to be something I can visualise, debug and maintain by hand, with no restriction on who can reach it.
A platform that cannot offer that is a business-cessation scenario for me, and I decline the service.
